name: Aurelio Okonkwo-Bertrand
description: A Tier 5 neural-feed star whose signature is characterized by what critics call 'sovereign distance' — audiences feel simultaneously close to and unreachable by his characters, producing an addictive longing that Vantablack has monetized aggressively. Of Congolese-French-Peruvian descent, Okonkwo-Bertrand carries significant geneware modifications including a bioluminescent dermal layer visible in low light, which has become part of his public persona. He is the face of four active Vantablack franchise properties and reportedly earns more in residual neural-signature licensing than any other living performer.
cultural_impact: His face — and the particular emotional register of his feed performances — became the unofficial aesthetic of Vantablack's premium tier branding throughout the 2210s.
story_hooks: He quietly commissions an independent neural technician to map his baseline signature before modification, and the results suggest the alterations go deeper than anyone suspected.
A rival corponation approaches him with an offer that would require breaking his Vantablack contract — and they have leverage that makes refusal complicated.
A grassroots movement among neural-feed addicts claims his signature is physiologically habit-forming, and the medical data supporting the claim is hard to dismiss.
